consumed_by: music_studio/planner.py (0-10 knob value -> deterministic graded prose clause; architecture s3.4) and music_studio/capabilities.py (the named presets the UI combos offer beside each slider)
provenance_rule: THE TIER STRUCTURE IS IMPORTED IN SHAPE FROM data/mood_orbit_lexicon.json (same graded-language pattern, same determinism rule) so the two graded surfaces cannot drift apart by hand. THE ENDPOINT PHRASES ARE THE ARCHITECTURE'S OWN, quoted from docs/music-studio-single-endpoint-architecture.md s3.4 lines 718-721, read 2026-08-15: 'a graded prose clause from the same lexicon as 3.2 ("sparse, patient percussion" ... "dense, driving sixteenth-note percussion")'. The register is the measured one for these engines - plain concrete words, direct action verbs, no literary description, no equipment vocabulary. Identical knob values always produce an identical clause, and the clause is returned in bindings.controls.<knob>.sent so an accepted-and-ignored knob is impossible to mistake for a working one.
why_five_tiers_and_not_eleven: The UI slider keeps its full 0-10 integer range (constraints min/max/step are unchanged). These five NAMED presets are what his order requires beside it - 'tüm herşeyde maximum predefined değerlerimiz olmalı kullanıcının arayüzde combolarla seçimlerle seçebileceği', 2026-08-14 - exactly as tempo_bpm carries eight named BPM presets beside its 40-220 slider. Eleven distinct prose clauses per knob would assert a resolution nothing has measured: no A/B has yet shown these engines distinguish 6 from 7. Five tiers are the honest granularity, and the tier a raw value lands in is reported back.

harmony_complexity.measure_candidate: granularity_scale (SCHEMA-present on one worker; NOT generation-proven as a harmony control, so it is not wired - build step 6b A/B is his decision)

clauses.very_low: harmony built on two or three plain chords that stay put
clauses.low: simple diatonic harmony with one clear turnaround
clauses.medium: diatonic harmony with a few borrowed chords and one modulation
clauses.high: rich harmony with extended chords, secondary dominants and a key change
clauses.very_high: dense chromatic harmony that shifts key more than once and leans on altered chords

rhythm_density.measure_candidate: NONE. Architecture s3.4 refuses to bind this slider to guidance_scale: 'That is an invented mapping presented as a control - the accepted-and-ignored class this project has paid for four times.' The honest mapping requires an A/B that measures ONSET DENSITY on delivered audio, which costs money and is therefore his decision.

clauses.low: steady, unhurried percussion on the main beats
clauses.medium: a full backbeat with regular eighth-note movement
clauses.high: busy percussion with sixteenth-note movement and fills between phrases

rhythm_density.endpoint_phrases_are_verbatim_from: architecture s3.4 line 720 - the very_low and very_high clauses are the architecture's own strings, reproduced CHARACTER-FOR-CHARACTER with nothing appended (a first draft of this file added tails such as 'that leaves long gaps', which scripts/test_knob_grade_lexicon.py caught and refused: a quotation with an addition is not a quotation, rules/01 s11). The three middle tiers are ours, written in the same register.

sonic_polish.measure_candidate: the guidance_scale family / creativity (SCHEMA-present on several workers; not generation-proven as a polish control on the Google-only routes after D-SSM-24 removed the third-party carriers)

clauses.very_low: raw and unpolished, room sound left in
clauses.low: lightly cleaned up, still natural and close
clauses.medium: a clean balanced mix with even levels
clauses.high: a polished mix with clear separation and controlled low end
clauses.very_high: a fully finished master, wide and glossy, every part sitting in its own space

combination_rule: each knob renders as its tier's clause; the clauses are joined with '; ' in the fixed order harmony_complexity, rhythm_density, sonic_polish so the prompt is byte-identical for identical input; a knob left at its default still renders (the default is a real request value, not an absence)
